user.title: Connect your Trek 4200
user.description: Select your Trek or enter its Bluetooth address. Close FSpower on all phones first. Only the Trek 4200 protocol has been tested. Setup will request telemetry to verify compatibility; it does not change outputs or settings.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up Trek 4200?
bluetooth_confirm.description: A possible Trek was found at {address}. Continue only if this is your Pion Power Trek 4200. Close FSpower on all phones first. Setup will verify a live telemetry response. Other FSpower devices are not confirmed compatible.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the Trek. Close FSpower on both phones, check Bluetooth range, and ensure an active proxy connection slot is free. Then retry.
error.unsupported_device: The device did not return the tested Trek telemetry format. Only the Trek 4200 is currently supported.
error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
error.insufficient_mtu: The Bluetooth connection negotiated an MTU below 89. Try another supported adapter or an active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Trek candidate.
